==About me==

I'm a high school aged guy who despises poor grammar and loves The Wheel of Time!  This is my first account on a Wiki, so I look forward to learning how everything works.  I'm a pretty knowledgeable guy about The Wheel of Time itself, but my Wiki skills are unlearned, so try to bear with me.  Thanks!

==WoT Experience==

I've tried just about everything through the years I've known WoT.  I'm a (fairly inactive) officer in the largest WoT Facebook group, read through the series nearly twelve times, joined a WoT Roleplaying Site, tried out WoTMUD, read through all of Burnout's ''WoT Now?'', and played the WoT RPG among other things.  I'm also an avid reader of whacko theories, so I know what's what with Asmodean, Demandred, etc.  In general, I think the WoT is a load of fun and I look forward to contributing.

==Works in Progress==

Through the course of my next read through (I'm currently in {{loc|14}}) I hope to finish up most of the Chapter Summary pages.  That task may be a bit daunting for one person though, haha.  In the meanwhile, I'll probably run regular grammar nazi patrols and generally fix the diction and rhetoric of articles.
